rationale: No existing Traces spec exercises the LLM Preview pane (TraceDetailsSidebar + LLMContentRenderer) or GenAI v5 `parts` rendering. traceDetails.spec.js only covers timeline toggle, copy-ID, related-logs, in-trace search, and share-link; tracesSearch.spec.js covers search/navigation only. A grep for `gen_ai|LLM|thread|parts|sidebar` across tests/ui-testing/playwright-tests returned no matches for these surfaces (only the unrelated Logs detail-sidebar regression). This is a genuinely new feature area, so a new spec is required and must be registered in ci_matrix.json's Traces shard.
